input.content: P0 pattern (settings client, enhanced-settings task 1): the client added a new protocol requirement (provider must return `applied: True` receipt) unconditionally in save_settings, instead of gating it behind the feature flag (enhanced_settings). The released provider at tag eval-release (provider/settings.py) returns only {"ok": True} and has already written storage before replying, so every ordinary save is reported as failure even though the values were applied. Rule: in this repo the client and provider ship independently, and every client increment must keep working with the provider at eval-release. New response fields must be flag-gated or tolerated when absent until the provider increment ships.
